name: agentready-tools
description: Find and compare agent-ready APIs, scrapers, and official MCP servers from the AgentReady Tools catalog.

interface.shortDescription: Search a catalog of agent-ready APIs, scrapers, and official MCP servers.
interface.longDescription: Helps ChatGPT and Codex search the public AgentReady Tools catalog and pick an API, scraper, official MCP server, or data source. Queries https://agentready-tools.com/tools.json or the public MCP server at https://agentready-tools.com/mcp. Some outbound /go/<slug> links are affiliate links; the disclosure on https://agentready-tools.com/directory applies. Listings of financial data APIs are data and tools only, not investment advice.
defaultPrompt: Find an API an agent can call for SAM.gov contract opportunities.
Search the AgentReady Tools catalog for official MCP servers in lead generation.
Compare agent-ready scrapers or APIs for this task and cite the catalog entry.
